name: Hermite Interpolation of Scalar Fields
definition: A technique for rendering scalar valued functions (height and signed distance fields) by storing partial derivatives with function values and using Hermite interpolation between samples to guarantee a globally C¹-continuous result.
summary: Hermite Interpolation of Scalar Fields renders continuous scalar fields by storing partial derivatives alongside values, using gradient information to construct a globally C1-continuous surface that replaces normal mapping with richer visual appearance.
